all_blocks.heading: Does the assessment guarantee accurate AI results?
all_blocks.label: Poor Citability
all_blocks.preview: No. No consultant can guarantee the accuracy of AI output. The assessment identifies conditions that may improve reliability, governance, security, and human oversight.

all_blocks.heading: Do you need access to our Salesforce production environment?
all_blocks.label: Low Citability
all_blocks.preview: Most assessments require approved access to Salesforce configuration, documentation, reports, exports, or a combination of those sources. The access method is confirmed before work begins.

all_blocks.heading: Will you review our actual data?
all_blocks.label: Poor Citability
all_blocks.preview: Yes, when the agreed scope includes data profiling and the organization provides approved access or extracts. CCC follows the agreed data-handling and confidentiality requirements.

all_blocks.heading: Is this a security audit?
all_blocks.label: Low Citability
all_blocks.preview: It includes a review of Salesforce access, permissions, sharing, and related risks within the agreed scope. It is not a penetration test, legal audit, or formal compliance certification.

all_blocks.heading: Is this only for organizations using Agentforce?
all_blocks.label: Low Citability
all_blocks.preview: No. The assessment can support other Salesforce AI initiatives, advanced automation, data-intensive projects, or leadership teams that need to evaluate whether their Salesforce environment is ready for increased automation.

all_blocks.heading: Can this be used before purchasing Agentforce?
